name: Sortland Bridge
facts: Built in 1975, the Sortland Bridge spans 948 metres, featuring a 150‑metre cantilever main span that lets ships pass beneath with a 30‑metre clearance.
During the 1970s, it joined a quartet of new links—alongside Hadsel, Andøy, and Kvalsaukan bridges—uniting Vesterålen’s islands into a single road network.
Before the bridge, a bustling ferry crossed Sortlandssundet; the new structure eliminated the ferry’s heavy traffic, transforming regional travel.
